Messages.Author: Patrick Drapeau
Messages.Body:
We have a guy who is playing this weenee toreador vote deck. He claims
that he can play Scorn of Adonis after people have casted votes to make
them lose blood from their pool. But on the cards, it reads: "casting". I
am not speaking english perfectly, but this seems to be present
continuous. I would interpret it that if you play SOA before everybody
casting votes, they will lose blood but you cant wait after they did it to
make them lose it. This matter have made his deck too much powerful:
nobody wants to take the chance to cast votes against his deck.
Please tell me i am right...

Patrick Drapeau

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
13...@quebectel.com (Patrick Drapeau) writes:



You used to be right, if that's any consolation.

The latest ruling on this card is that it can be played before or after
votes are cast, resulting in pool loss for any Methuselah whose votes
were cast or or are cast against the referendum. "Casting" can also be
as a continuous state: "Wearing Black" "Breathing Normally" "Voting Against"
- that is, as an adjective modifier instead of an action.
